notes: Run() computes Input[tid*4] = 0xa0000000 + tid*0x01010101, Input[tid*4+1] = 69 + tid; Input[tid*4+2..3] stay 0. The idxen loads use stride 4 bytes with index tid*4, i.e. byte offset tid*16, so lane tid reads exactly that 4-dword row.

Exactly 32 rows (one wave32): v_readlane lane 37 wraps to lane 5 and v_readfirstlane reads lane 0, so the row count and wave size must match the test; Check() expects {Input[5*4], Input[5*4], 69} in every lane.
All three columns are asserted by Check().
